society.skycraft.say.region.summerset_is: White limestone cliffs, terraced vineyards, and faceted glass towers rise across Summerset Isle from Alinor and Shimmerene to Cloudrest and Lillandril.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.1: The larger island is the most ordered land in Tamriel.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.2: Alinor's sixteen avenues radiate from the Crystal Tower's sight-line;.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.3: Shimmerene is the one port where outsiders crowd into a permit quarter;.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.4: Here in Summerset Isle, the land is shaped by the central granite upland around the Crystal Tower, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.5: Watch the sky when noon light refracting off crystal spires sets in across Summerset Isle—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.6: Our people draw their living along white-stone aqueducts feeding the capital, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.7: Don't stray far into glittering white beaches after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.8: The markets of Summerset Isle turn on glass, crystal lenses and court patronage, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.9: From the sixteen-avenue capital, the watch-horns carry clear across warm southern coral shelf.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.10: Ask anyone in Summerset Isle who holds the reins and they'll point you to ancient noble lineages of the capital.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of Sapiarch ancestor liturgy at the Crystal Tower.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.12: Tempers run sharp over quiet lineage resistance to Justiciar oversight whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through Summerset Isle.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.13: Give a wide berth to the Corgrad, Direnni, Rellenthil, Sil-Var-Woad, Sunhold and Welenkin vents—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.14: The elders still tell of the empty white acropolis of the departed clan, written into the stones of Summerset Isle.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.15: Between the central granite upland around the Crystal Tower and the clear springs of Norlor, Calinaan and Faaril, there's no mistaking the borders of Summerset Isle.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.16: When sea fogs around Lillandril and Cloudrest sweeps over terraced hills of grape and olive, even veteran guides keep to Shimmerene, Dusk and Sunhold.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.17: Traders dealing in the southern open customs port always pay their dues to walled dock quarter for foreign factors before unlashing a single bale.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.18: You can still see the mark of villages whose Imperial-era names survive only on contraband charts near upland spider-cult caverns, if you know where to look.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.19: Whether you answer to ancient noble lineages of the capital or just haul glass, crystal lenses and court patronage, coastal panic over rising abyssal vents touches every hearth in Summerset Isle.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.20: At the shrines of gardens of geometry as devotion, travelers leave offerings before crossing warm southern coral shelf.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.21: Out beyond the sixteen-avenue capital, terraced hills of grape and olive and the Corgrad, Direnni, Rellenthil, Sil-Var-Woad, Sunhold and Welenkin vents test anyone who wanders off the beaten track.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.22: Every season in Summerset Isle is measured by noon light refracting off crystal spires and the flow of white-stone aqueducts feeding the capital.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.23: The factors who handle glass, crystal lenses and court patronage say quiet lineage resistance to Justiciar oversight has doubled the price of guards along the clear springs of Norlor, Calinaan and Faaril.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.24: No mason in Summerset Isle forgets the empty white acropolis of the departed clan when laying foundations over the central granite upland around the Crystal Tower.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.25: If you seek work in Summerset Isle, look to the southern open customs port or sign on with the wardens watching upland spider-cult caverns.
society.skycraft.say.summerset_isle.26: Old songs in Shimmerene, Dusk and Sunhold still name villages whose Imperial-era names survive only on contraband charts and the vows of Sapiarch ancestor liturgy at the Crystal Tower.

society.skycraft.say.region.auridon: Guarding the eastern strait between Summerset and the mainland, Auridon pairs the ancient kinlord citadel of Firsthold with the open port of Vulkhel Guard.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.1: Auridon is the warmer northern island, Summerset's front door and its military front line facing the continent.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.2: Foreign ships must land at Vulkhel Guard's open quays;.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.3: Firsthold sits on a tidal rock reached by a low causeway, and Skywatch crowns its hill under a great brass orrery.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.4: Here in Auridon, the land is shaped by Auridon's central limestone and granite spine, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.5: Watch the sky when warm, humid breezes off the Abecean sets in across Auridon—it changes the roads in an hour.

society.skycraft.say.auridon.7: Don't stray far into coastal palms and flowering broadleaf after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.8: The markets of Auridon turn on customs, ship repair and foreign factor trade, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.9: From the northern court city on its tidal rock, the watch-horns carry clear across Firsthold's tidal headland and causeway shelf.
society.skycraft.say.auridon.10: Ask anyone in Auridon who holds the reins and they'll point you to Dominion naval officers and coastal watches.

society.skycraft.say.auridon.13: Give a wide berth to sea-elf invasion camps, sea caves and wrecks—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.

society.skycraft.say.region.artaeum: Veiled in pearl mist and lotus meadows around ancient Ceporah Tower, the island of Artaeum shelters the Psijic Order and its relic vaults.
society.skycraft.say.artaeum.1: Artaeum is the Psijic Order's island off Summerset, there in the mist and sometimes not in the mortal world at all.
society.skycraft.say.artaeum.2: Ceporah Tower, the Grand Psijic Villa and a ruined older college stand among quiet lotus pools under the Statue of Syrabane.
society.skycraft.say.artaeum.3: The Order keeps the Old Ways and dangerous relics no one else may touch;.
society.skycraft.say.artaeum.4: Here in Artaeum, the land is shaped by white limestone cliffs and pre-Aldmeri crystal outcrops rising from the western sea, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.artaeum.5: Watch the sky when a timeless silver mist volume that hides the island from uninvited ships sets in across Artaeum—it changes the roads in an hour.

society.skycraft.say.artaeum.10: Ask anyone in Artaeum who holds the reins and they'll point you to monks, initiates, loremasters and the Ritemaster chosen by merit, not lineage.
